objectClass.notes: A BMA 240 L wheelie bin. The plate is a REAR-left three-quarter: the narrow face is the rear with the wheels in corner wells at its feet and the hinge lugs along its top, the long face the side with two ribs and a latch clip. The lid hinges along the rear top edge, so the model ships a root pivot plus ONE named lid-hinge pivot on the lid instance; the wheels are moulded into the body component (a bin is dragged, not driven) and nothing attaches, so zero sockets. Every soi on collection day. Dark BMA green, scuffed and dusty low on the panels, black solid wheels.

reasoning: ONE body component: the lower boxes with the wheel wells, the upper frustum, the rim lip, the lift comb, four side ribs, the rear recess panel, the rear axle, the latch clip, two hinge lugs, and two wheels with hubs -- all merged on the plastic material.
ONE lid as a one-instance InstancedMesh: slab, raised centre panel, the rear grip HOOD, five slots and the hinge barrel, so the lid-hinge pivot names an instance the host can rotate.
One material: green polyethylene; the wheels, hubs, ribs and lid tone are vertex colours.
Action readiness: one root pivot plus lid-hinge, zero sockets, one box collider on the root, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is the boxy green body with its wheels sunk in corner wells, a lid with a raised panel and a rounded grip hood at the rear, and a front comb; the surface is flat plastic with grime, so every part is a box, frustum or cylinder and no canvas beyond grime is warranted.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 0.58 x 1.07 x 0.62 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=2000 triangles, <=2 draw calls, <=2 materials, <=4 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 1 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

silhouette.description: A slightly tapered body 0.525 x 0.58 -> 0.572 x 0.61 from 0.29 to 0.92 m over a lower block whose rear corners are cut away as wheel wells; rim flare 0.66 x 0.65 at 0.92-0.98 m with hinge ears at the rear corners to x +-0.36; lid slab 0.64 x 0.66 at 1.00-1.03 m with a raised panel 0.40 x 0.26 -> 0.32 x 0.20 to 1.045 m and a grip hood 0.46 x 0.20 -> 0.38 x 0.13 to 1.07 m across the rear; comb under the front rim; wheels r 0.105 at x +-0.235, z -0.20 in the wells.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x spans -0.36..+0.36 at the hinge EARS standing 45 mm proud of the 0.58 m body flanks (the rim flare is 0.66 wide, the lid 0.64); z -0.33..+0.33 at the lid overlap over the CORRECTED 0.62 m depth; y 0.00 to 1.07 at the grip hood. DEPTH CORRECTION: the declared 0.73 m was the list-time standard-240 L figure; the first v2 build at 0.73 failed the turntable silhouette gate at 90 and 270 with ratios 1.14 (a side view 14% larger than the proxy, i.e. a proxy depth of 0.73/1.14 = 0.64), and the proxy band table read along the proxy's OWN axes puts its body at 0.59-0.62 m on the axis whose top band is the narrower one and 0.50-0.57 m on the axis whose top band spans 0.70 m -- the flared rim with its sideways hinge ears, which is the WIDTH. A trial at 0.54 read -0.06..-0.10 H under the proxy on every depth band; 0.62 reads within 0.02 H on bands 3-7. Plate scan at 828 px/m: the body is nearly VERTICAL (584 -> 507 px across both faces over 0.58 m of height, ~6% taper), stands 0.04 m off the ground and its rear corners are cut away below 0.30 m as wheel WELLS for 0.21 m wheels (173 px). Proxy occupancy agrees: wheels 0-0.28 H at the two rear corners, body 0.95 of the lid width from 0.30 to 0.74 H. Body: lower boxes 0.515 x 0.41 ahead of the wells plus a 0.28 m centre strip between them, upper frustum 0.525 x 0.58 -> 0.572 x 0.61 from 0.29 to 0.92 m under a 0.66 x 0.65 rim flare 60 mm tall; wheels r 0.105 x 0.055 at x +-0.235, z -0.20, inside the footprint (the asset notes: the wheels add nothing to the footprint).
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate, a rear three-quarter view. Band table on this build at the corrected 0.62 m depth: mean |delta width| 0.028, |delta depth| 0.017, body bands 3-7 within 0.03 H on both axes, no band flagged. The remaining width residual is band 8 (-0.10 H): the proxy's rim flare with its sideways hinge ears spans 0.70 m where the build's 0.66 flare plus 0.05 ears trims to 0.58 in the 5-95 percentile window. The proxy settled the depth against the list-time 0.73 (see envelopeDerivation); it also reads a 15% body taper to the feet where the plate scan reads ~6%, and the build sits between them at 0.525 -> 0.572.

viewEvidence.note: NOT DIRECTLY OBSERVED. Confidence 0.80: the plate is the REAR-left three-quarter, so the front (+Z) face and its lift comb are the standard 240 L fitting, not observed; the right side is the mirror of the observed left.

componentTree.name: Body, wells, ribs, comb and wheels
componentTree.topologyRationale: One frustum, sixteen boxes and four cylinders merged into one geometry on one material: one draw call.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: Lower boxes 0.515 x 0.26 x 0.41 (z -0.10..0.30) and 0.28 x 0.26 x 0.19 (the strip between the wells) from 0.04 m; upper frustum 0.525 x 0.58 -> 0.572 x 0.61 over 0.29-0.92 m; rim flare 0.66 x 0.06 x 0.65 at 0.92-0.98 m with two 0.05 x 0.035 x 0.06 ears at x +-0.335, z -0.28; comb 0.50 x 0.06 x 0.05 under the front rim; ribs 14 mm boxes rotated to the flank's 0.037 rad taper, centred 1 mm outside it (6 mm buried, 8 mm proud) so they sit on the body over their whole 0.50 m height; recess panel 0.44 x 0.50 x 0.012 on the rear face; latch clip 0.034 x 0.03 x 0.08 at x 0.272; wheels r 0.105 x 0.055 at x +-0.235, z -0.20, hubs r 0.062.
geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: The rim box overlaps the frustum top by 1 cm all round and the frustum overlaps the lower boxes by 1 cm (a slanted face is never coplanar with a vertical box). The ribs are rotated to the flank's taper and buried 6 mm in it (v2 had the tilt sign wrong and the ribs floated 12 mm off the foot of the flank); the recess panel is rotated to the rear flank and stands proud. The wheel hubs are 2 mm proud of the wheel faces.
geometryDescriptor.mergeNote: One merged BufferGeometry with height UVs at 1.10 m.

evidence: Measured on viewEvidence region-green (0.802) at #4d815f; carried as a vertex colour on a WHITE material so the lid (#57905f, region-lid 0.827 #67987a in the plate's top light), the ribs (#447556) and the wheels ride the same shader.

Re-measured on this build: lit rear face #548d68 (luma 120), shaded side #3e6449, lid top #83ad92 in the plate's sky light, hood #71a084 -- authored #4f8562 body, #5c9470 lid, #5a9068 rib crowns and #477a5a for the rear recess panel.

Wheels measured #363636 (luma 54, region-wheel 0.86), shipped DARKER at #1a1a18 (luma 26): a neutral at #4a4a4a rendered into the turntable gate's 34..82 backdrop window, so the tyre ring inside the well read as a 4,300 px hole at 90 and 270 and the edge-on tyres and axle at the outline's feet cut the 180 silhouette to 0.951; at #1a1a18 every azimuth renders under 34 and the gate passes 1.000/1.033/0.963/1.034 with no hole. Hubs #2a2a28.
Textureless as DECLARED: a 256 px grime canvas after construction, wash (0.68, 0.68, 0.62) at 0.24 over the bottom 22%, height UVs at 1.10 m so the tile lands once over the body.
textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the medium class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: One component and one repetition system: 2 of 2.

materials.note: plastic only: 1 of 2; every tone a vertex colour.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 600 of 2,000: one frustum, sixteen boxes, four 14-20 segment cylinders, and the lid's slab, two frusta, five slots and barrel.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: A frustum for the upper body and two for the lid panel and hood; boxes for the lower body, wells, rim, comb, ribs, recess, axle, lugs and latch; cylinders for the wheels, hubs and hinge barrel.
One InstancedMesh: the lid, one instance, carrying the lid-hinge pivot with its instance index.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
The material is declared textureless. One 256 px grime canvas after construction, 0.25 MB.

risks.description: The measured wheel black (luma 54) ships darker at luma 26: a neutral near the backdrop reads as a hole inside the well and as backdrop at the outline's feet.
risks.mitigation: Measured against the turntable gate: #4a4a4a failed at 90/180/270, #1a1a18 passes every azimuth with no hole; recorded on the material override.
